anne_ml: Quick summary from yesterday's bench: ran nova-slim-10b int6 vs int8 on our summarization+multi-turn traces. Topline: int6 ~2.7x cheaper per token but shows a modest quality regression on long-context summarization (~3.5% absolute QA drop). p50 slightly better, p95 +35-45ms for >1k tokens.

rob_prod: Need per-request econ delta and traffic-weighted impact for GTN.

anne_ml: Baseline nova-slim-10b int8: cost $0.0098/1k tokens, p50=90ms, p95=220ms, QA=81.7. int6: cost $0.0036/1k tokens, p50=83ms, p95=260ms, QA=78.2. Numbers from production-like sample, slice-weighted.

liz_eval: Long-dialog slice (avg ~1.4k tokens) shows precision drop ~4.0% and slight factuality alerts uptick. Short-turn chats are near-parity. No catastrophic failures in 5k sample.

kevin_platform: Proposed routing: default int6 for <=1024 tokens; 1025-2048 run small canary (15% int6 / 85% int8); >2048 stick to int8. I'll encode as a route rule and add tracing for KV-cache variance.

rob_prod: Abort thresholds suggestion: weighted QA delta >2.5% OR hallucination alerts +30% OR p95 latency +20% => auto-rollback. Also manual qualitative QC at 24h (1k sample).

anne_ml: Econ impact estimate: hybrid gives ~26% token-cost reduction vs all-int8, ~ $9-13k/mo savings depending on spend. Weighted QA hit ~ -0.5% overall. Recommend canary with 30% spike for 2h then 15% for 46h.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=3467001250, initial_pct=30, followup_pct=15, monitors=QA,hallucination,latency.

liz_eval: I'll post 24h qualitative readout here. Early 6h checks look tolerable but summaries slightly more generic.

kevin_platform: Dashboard and runbook updated. If alerts breach, fallback to opt13b-int8 and pause rollout.

rob_prod: Sounds good. Keep thread updated with QC and metrics. :thumbsup:
